name: the-learning-loft
description: The Learning Loft — education center website (Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite database)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
